WITH price_bands AS (
  SELECT 
    i.ref_id,
    i.prc,
    CASE 
      WHEN i.prc < 15 THEN 'under_15'
      WHEN i.prc >= 15 AND i.prc < 30 THEN '15_to_30'
      WHEN i.prc >= 30 AND i.prc < 60 THEN '30_to_60'
      ELSE '60_or_more'
    END AS band
  FROM items_g1 i
  WHERE i.main_cat = 'Office Products' AND i.prc IS NOT NULL
),
band_ratings AS (
  SELECT 
    pb.band,
    AVG(f.rtg) AS avg_rating
  FROM price_bands pb
  JOIN fdbk_g1 f ON pb.ref_id = f.ref_id
  WHERE f.vrf = 1
  GROUP BY pb.band
)
SELECT 
  MAX(avg_rating) - MIN(avg_rating) AS gap
FROM band_ratings;
